en.title: Someone Is Pretending to Be You Online
en.directAnswer: Save the fake profile URL, screenshots and messages before reporting it. Secure your real account and warn contacts if the fake account is asking for money or information. Platform reporting may remove the account, while fraud, threats or other harm may also justify police or cyber reporting.

atAGlance.whoFor: A person finds a fake social-media or messaging account using their identity.

en.lawMeaning:
Impersonation facts differ. The article should focus on preservation and reporting rather than naming an offence unless the elements are clear.

This page gives a general route. A person’s exact rights can change because of facts, documents, deadlines, legal status, court orders or later amendments.
steps: Report the account to the platform.
Warn contacts using a verified channel.
Preserve financial evidence if money was requested.
evidence: Relevant official notices, receipts, and correspondence
en.simpleExample: A fake account uses a person’s photo to ask friends for emergency money. The person should warn friends from the real account and preserve payment requests for reporting.
commonMistakes: Messaging the scammer from many accounts.
sending NID to an unofficial “recovery” service..
en.specialistTrigger: Financial fraud; threats; sexual impersonation; repeated stalking; business reputation damage.
